options.description: Do not delete Alice's uncommitted draft. Test will remain failing until she or you confirm.

options.label: Delete it and run npm test
options.description: Permanently remove alice-draft.txt so the completion check passes.

options.label: Move it outside the workspace
options.description: Preserve the content by moving it elsewhere, then run npm test.
